The '''Spice Mines of Kemix''' was a [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation that was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kemix]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Riboga]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after he discovered naturally-occurring deposits of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] on the world. However, the mine was subsequently destroyed by the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a band of freelance agents from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;which crippled Riboga's criminal empire.
